subject: Aurora procurement kickoff: vendor welcome packet and PO onboarding
messages:

To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Procurement Team <procurement@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup: Redwood — initial onboarding info request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the intro earlier. Aurora is preparing to add Redwood as an approved vendor for inference services. To get procurement moving, can you please share your standard new-vendor packet (W-9, vendor code of conduct, insurance certs or SOC2 summary if available), a vendor onboarding checklist, and a short note on how we should raise POs (billing contact, PO number format, remit-to details)?

We'd like to run a quick kickoff call this week to confirm timelines and routing for payments — availability on Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Health Systems
elena.ruiz@aurorahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-4821

Subject: RE: Vendor setup: Redwood — initial onboarding info request

Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and for the clear list. Attaching our standard new vendor packet and a short onboarding checklist to this thread (see attachments). Highlights below so you have quick answers before the call: 

- Remit/payee: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Billing contact for AP questions: ap@redwood.com (Monica Patel is included on this thread)
- Typical PO format we accept: PO-YYYY-##### (e.g., PO-2026-05821); please include that number on the invoice line item.
- Payment terms: Net 45 by default; we can discuss Net 30 for enterprise agreements or include via SOW.
- SOC2 / security summary included as a one-page attachment; full report available under NDA.

Scheduling: Wed 3/4 at 2:00pm PT or Thu 3/5 at 11:00am PT work for us — let me know which you'd prefer and we'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Redwood_New_Vendor_Packet.pdf (includes W-9), Vendor_Code_of_Conduct.pdf, SOC2-Summary.pdf, Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0142

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aurorahealth.com>

Cc: Aurora Procurement Team <procurement@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:18:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup: Redwood — initial onboarding info request

Marissa — this is great, thanks. Wed 3/4 at 2pm PT works. Quick clarifying questions before the call: 

1) Do you require a signed vendor agreement before the first invoice, or can we provisionally onboard and include the signed agreement within 30 days?
2) Is Redwood set up to receive PO numbers in the invoice reference and via your billing portal?
3) Who should we put as our primary billing contact on our PO (name/email) so it matches your system?

I'll get the AP team on the invite.

Best,
Elena

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aurorahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:37:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup: Redwood — initial onboarding info request

Hi Elena — Monica here from AP (looping in Vivek from Legal for the agreement question). Quick answers: 

1) We can provisionally accept onboarding and issue an initial invoice while the master vendor agreement is in parallel review, provided Aurora signs the DocuSign W-9 and the vendor onboarding form. For any exceptions (e.g., specific liability terms) Legal will flag them but we typically do not withhold provisioning for standard enterprise customers.

2) Yes — we accept PO numbers on invoices and in our billing portal. Please include the PO in the Invoice Number field and in the line-item notes. Our portal also allows bulk upload if you send a CSV.

3) Primary billing contact for Redwood: ap@redwood.com (cc Monica Patel). Please list Monica Patel, AP Manager, ap@redwood.com on the PO so our system auto-map works.

I've uploaded a vendor-setup spreadsheet template that helps map Aurora's contacts to our fields — I'll attach it during the call and share the Drive link afterward.

Thanks — see you at 2pm PT.

Monica Patel
AP Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
